meta.title: Brick Calico
meta.subtitle: A life-size calico house cat, built from standard bricks.
meta.footer: Built at 1:1 scale — one stud is 8 mm, so she stands about 25 cm tall from the ground to her ear tips, the size of a real sitting house cat. Studs-up sculpture using only standard 1×1 through 2×6 bricks; the interior is solid, so every brick locks to the layer beneath it. Two lime 1×1s for the eyes and one bright-pink 1×2 for the nose.
